title: DNA extraction: Mastermix creation
author: Opentrons
materials: Master Mix Distribution and Sample Transfer](./022548-
The bead mix is mixed ten times.

steps.title: Set up source reservoirs
steps.instruction: Place a NEST 12‑well reservoir for large volumes or a tuberack for small volumes on the deck. Designate the wells that contain binding buffer and bead mix according to the user‑specified ranges (e.g., binding buffer wells 1‑4, bead mix wells 5‑6). Record the volume of binding buffer per source well (mL) and volume of bead mix per source well (mL). The mastermix will be assembled in the well immediately after the last designated source well, using as many wells as needed for the requested number of samples. Include a dead volume equal to one‑third of the total well volume (maximum 9.54 mL per well, of which 1 mL is active volume for reservoirs) to prevent air aspiration during later dispensing.

steps.title: Distribute binding buffer
steps.instruction: Using the P300 single‑channel or multi‑channel pipette mounted on the specified side, aspirate the defined volume of binding buffer from each designated binding‑buffer source well and dispense into the corresponding mastermix target wells, respecting the calculated total volume (active + dead) per well. Adjust tip height during aspiration to account for the decreasing liquid level and avoid plunging too deep.

steps.title: Mix bead suspension
steps.instruction: Aspirate the bead mix from its source well(s) with the P300 pipette and mix the bead suspension by pipetting up and down ten times to ensure homogeneity.

steps.title: Distribute bead mix
steps.instruction: Dispense the mixed bead mix from the source well(s) into the mastermix target wells using the same pipette, again observing the total volume limit per well.

steps.title: Mix final mastermix
steps.instruction: Mix the assembled mastermix by pipetting up and down the number of times specified by the user‑defined mix count parameter.
